question: Where was the final match of Indian Premier League (IPL) 2022 played?
solution:
The correct answer is **'****__Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad__'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **final match** of the **Indian Premier League (IPL) 2022 **was played at the **Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad**.
 
• A record-breaking **101,566 fans** watched the IPL 2022 final match, which earned it a place in the **Guinness Book of World Records**.
 
• In the Indian Premier League (IPL) 2022 final match, the title was won by the **Gujarat Titans** after defeating **Rajasthan Royals**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The men's **T20** franchise Indian cricket league is called the** Indian Premier League (IPL)**.
 
• The game comprises of **ten teams**, each from a different city and state, competing in it every year.
 
• The Indian Premier League (IPL) was founded by the **Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)** in **2007**.
 
• IPL typically takes place in the months of **March through May** every year in India and has a special window in the **ICC Future Tours Programme**.
